source: 人教版2019必修一 Unit 2 词表(p119-120 真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、旅行主题、含目标词、不超纲。

words.example_en: We visited an old castle on the hill.
words.example_cn: 我们参观了山上一座古老的城堡。

words.example_en: You must apply for a visa before the trip.
words.example_cn: 旅行前你必须申请签证。

words.example_en: It took two weeks to get my visa.
words.example_cn: 办我的签证花了两周。

words.example_en: We rented a car to explore the island.
words.example_cn: 我们租了辆车去探索这座岛。

words.example_en: Don't forget to pack your warm clothes.
words.example_cn: 别忘了把保暖衣物装进行李。

words.meaning_cn: 令人惊奇的;令人惊喜的
words.example_en: The mountains gave us an amazing view.
words.example_cn: 群山给了我们令人惊叹的景色。

words.example_en: I was amazed at the size of the old city.
words.example_cn: 我对这座古城的规模感到惊讶。

words.example_en: She made all the arrangements for the journey.
words.example_cn: 她安排好了旅程的一切。

words.example_en: The lake was extremely beautiful at sunrise.
words.example_cn: 日出时湖面极其美丽。

words.example_en: They walked to the source of the river.
words.example_cn: 他们走到了这条河的源头。

words.example_en: We climbed up a narrow mountain path.
words.example_cn: 我们沿着一条狭窄的山路往上爬。

words.example_en: After the hills, the road became flat.
words.example_cn: 翻过山丘后,路变得平坦了。

words.example_en: The guide explained the history in detail.
words.example_cn: 导游详细讲解了这段历史。

words.example_en: The Inca built a powerful empire long ago.
words.example_cn: 很久以前印加人建立了一个强大的帝国。

words.example_en: Machu Picchu was part of the Inca Empire.
words.example_cn: 马丘比丘曾是印加帝国的一部分。

words.example_en: The city was built for a great emperor.
words.example_cn: 这座城是为一位伟大的皇帝而建。

words.example_en: This is a famous historical site in Peru.
words.example_cn: 这是秘鲁一处著名的历史遗址。

words.example_en: From the top we had a great view of the valley.
words.example_cn: 从山顶我们看到了山谷的壮丽景色。

words.example_en: We spent a day seeing the sights of the city.
words.example_cn: 我们花了一天游览城市的景点。

words.example_en: Spanish is the official language of Peru.
words.example_cn: 西班牙语是秘鲁的官方语言。

words.example_en: There is an old stone statue near the gate.
words.example_cn: 门旁有一尊古老的石雕像。

words.example_en: I could hardly recognise the old town.
words.example_cn: 我几乎认不出这座古镇了。

words.example_en: Workers unearthed an ancient tomb here.
words.example_cn: 工人在这里挖出了一座古墓。

words.example_en: Scientists unearthed a lost city in the jungle.
words.example_cn: 科学家在丛林中发掘出一座失落的城市。

words.example_en: This is a special type of mountain train.
words.example_cn: 这是一种特别的山地火车。

words.example_en: Many tourists made comments about the view.
words.example_cn: 许多游客对这景色发表了评论。

words.example_en: We booked an early flight to Peru.
words.example_cn: 我们订了一班飞往秘鲁的早班机。

words.example_en: We booked our accommodation online.
words.example_cn: 我们在网上订好了住处。

words.example_en: Each old city has its own unique culture.
words.example_cn: 每座古城都有自己独特的文化。

words.example_en: The path led us up to the temple.
words.example_cn: 这条小路带我们爬到了神庙。

words.example_en: Peru is a popular destination for hikers.
words.example_cn: 秘鲁是徒步者热门的目的地。

words.example_en: We stopped to admire the beautiful view.
words.example_cn: 我们停下来欣赏美丽的景色。

words.example_en: Tourists love the ancient architecture here.
words.example_cn: 游客们喜爱这里的古建筑。

words.example_en: A famous architect designed the bridge.
words.example_cn: 一位著名建筑师设计了这座桥。

words.example_en: She picked up a travel brochure at the airport.
words.example_cn: 她在机场拿了一本旅行手册。

words.example_en: The old fort once kept many soldiers.
words.example_cn: 这座古堡曾驻扎过许多士兵。

words.example_en: Public transport in the city is cheap and fast.
words.example_cn: 这座城市的公共交通又便宜又快。

words.example_en: We went for a long hike in the mountains.
words.example_cn: 我们到山里进行了一次长途徒步。

words.example_en: Tourism is important to the local economy.
words.example_cn: 旅游业对当地经济很重要。

words.example_en: Travel brings economic growth to small towns.
words.example_cn: 旅游给小城镇带来经济增长。

words.example_en: I made a request for a room with a view.
words.example_cn: 我请求要一间有景观的房间。
